text: Demand is outrunning delivery: about 1.3 items arrive for every one that finishes, and a single clean-up week makes the finish count look healthier than a typical week (around 10) really is. Nearly half of the demand that could be classified is reactive, so planned work is being squeezed by support and requests. Knowledge is concentrated: one person wrote most of the merged pull requests and nearly all of cluster-bootstrap, and the commit timestamps show that person working late nights and long runs far more than anyone else. Delegating this work would first need time to bring others up to speed.
